title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer `x`, return `true` if `x` is a palindrome, and `false` otherwise.

sample_tests.explanation: From left it is -121, from right 121-.

Convert to string and compare with its reverse.
Can also reverse the second half mathematically using modulo and division.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    s = data[0]
    print('true' if s == s[::-1] else 'false')
